nodes.label: Technology Tree Animation Frames 244-320 (Missing)
nodes.description: Animation frames 244-320 (step 4) of a looping technology tree visualization. The animation depicts a stylized tree whose canopy is composed of technology logos and UI dashboard panels — including AI, React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, MongoDB, GSAP, Apple, SharePoint, SPFx, Power Automate, PowerApps, Business Intelligence, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure AD, and Vea branding. Glowing blue roots extend downward suggesting connectivity. Frames in this chunk (244–320) are not present on disk; content inferred from adjacent frames 239–240 which are visually identical to the late-animation steady state.
